Expertise You Can Trust

At StreetWorks, we don’t just weld metal—we create masterpieces. Our custom auto body fabrication specialists have decades of experience working on some of the most prestigious exotic and classic cars, ensuring that every piece we touch is crafted to perfection.

Unique Solutions for Unique Cars

From interior to exterior, our team handles every panel and part with precision. If you need rare exotic car parts that you can’t find anywhere else, we’ve got you covered. Our custom metal fabricating starts with a design concept on paper and evolves into a wire mock-up, ensuring every detail is meticulously planned and executed.

State-of-the-Art Equipment

Our workshop is equipped with the latest technology and tools, including Pullmax machines, English Wheels, power hammers, and more. This enables us to deliver high-quality, precise results faster than traditional methods.

Unmatched Quality and Authenticity

When it comes to auto restoration, attention to authentic detail is paramount. Our team has proven expertise in restoring and fabricating parts for brands like Ferrari, Lamborghini, Bugatti, and Maserati. We ensure that every project meets the highest standards of quality and authenticity.

With extensive experience with everything from custom chassis fabrication for classic cars to welding car frame repair for luxury vehicles, StreetWorks treats every car like the most important car in our shop. Contact us today to discuss how our custom auto welding and fabrication services will get your car looking as good or better than when it first hit the road.
